blocks.text: Thank you for the introductions to your operations leads last week; they have already made a difference to how quickly we can get our bearings on the {{fact:f:E-2010-001.client}} supply chain. Daniel Leach has the first data pull open, and between the extract your team sent and those conversations we now have a workable picture of how goods move from your suppliers through to the point of use. Nothing in it has surprised us yet, which at this stage is exactly what we hope for.

To keep the baseline moving there are two things that would help from your side. The first is read access to the last two years of inventory and freight cost detail, which lets us set what the network carries today against a sensible reference point rather than an impression of one. The second is thirty minutes each with the two site managers Michael Walker flagged after the kickoff, since the operating detail behind the numbers tends to live with the people who run the floor.

If any of that needs a sign-off on your side, Sandra Flores, tell me who I should ask and I will approach them directly rather than put it back on your desk. Otherwise send whatever is easiest to me, Deborah Gordon, and we will keep this thread as the single place these requests and their answers live.
